title: Jen's Three-Bean Pumpkin Chili
description: A richer, gently spicy slow-cooker chili with kidney, black, and pinto beans, smoky spices, and pumpkin stirred in near the end for body and subtle sweetness.
source_name: Jen, adapted from Allrecipes The Ultimate Chili

ingredients.name: jalapeño, finely minced (remove seeds for milder heat)
dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Mexican-style stewed tomatoes (3 cans, 14.5 oz each)
canned pumpkin puree (not pumpkin pie filling)
kosher salt, plus more to taste
black pepper, plus more to taste
cayenne pepper (up to 0.5 tsp for more heat)

instructions.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook {0} ground beef until mostly browned. Drain excess fat if needed.

Add {1} onion and {3} jalapeño to the skillet and cook 4-5 minutes until the onion softens. Add {2} garlic and all dry spices ({16} chili powder, {17} cumin, {18} smoked paprika, {19} oregano, {20} coriander, {21} chipotle chili powder, {22} cayenne, {23} basil, and {24} cocoa powder if using). Stir 30-60 seconds until fragrant.

Transfer the beef mixture to the slow cooker. Add {4} kidney beans, {5} black beans, {6} pinto beans, {7} stewed tomatoes, {9} celery, {10} bell pepper, {11} red wine vinegar, and {13} Worcestershire sauce. Stir well. Do not add the pumpkin or wine yet.
Cook on LOW for 8 hours or HIGH for 6 hours.
Pour in {12} red wine during the final 2 hours of cooking.
Stir in {8} pumpkin puree about 90 minutes before serving on LOW, or 45-60 minutes before on HIGH. Stir thoroughly so it disappears into the chili and gently thickens the sauce.
Taste and adjust with {14} salt and {15} black pepper. For more heat, add extra cayenne or chipotle powder. For more brightness, add another teaspoon of {11} red wine vinegar.

notes: Kidney beans hold their texture for the classic chili feel, black beans add earthiness, and pinto beans go creamy and help bind the sauce. Use 1/2 cup pumpkin instead of 3/4 for a more subtle effect. Cocoa powder is optional but adds depth without any chocolate flavor. Freezes very well.
